title: The Pandemic Year Kobo360 Almost Ran Out of Money
conflicts: Episode moved from the slate's 2023 to the documented 2020-21 restructuring (in 2023 Ozor left for the Enugu State government). No IFC lawsuit against Ozor or Kobo360 was found in any source; TechCabal (2025) reports only the IFC's statement that it had not transferred or sold its shares, so no lawsuit is mentioned. Funding totals differ ($20m v $30m for 2019; $48m v $56m for the Series B); used $20m (CNN) and $48m (TechCrunch, TechCabal). TechCabal's own pieces disagree on when Mugambi became CEO (August 2023 v 2022) and left (November v October 2024); followed the contemporaneous reports.
notes: Story rests on Ozor's 2022 TechCrunch interview, with the lockdown impact from TechCabal and CNN (2020). The 2024-25 collapse is told briefly and with attribution: job cuts per employees, unpaid pensions per former staff, the company's HR-firm explanation, and the debt figure per a memo TechCabal saw. Stance 'complicates'. The reflection is about admitting where one's ability runs out.
